content: Activate the M0110/W0112 cdev worker lease seam: allow a generation-bound control lease to map the paired queue, provide a user-space CdevWorkerSession that validates and owns that mapping, and prove deterministic UAPI error mapping without changing the frozen ABI records.

Committed worker lease activation at 0b67854 with Agent Harness (codex) as Author and Committer. CdevWorkerSession validates generation/view/identity, exact paired-ring layout, and status mappings; the kernel control fops map queue offset zero for a valid lease. Focused cdev test passed 1/1, full development CTest passed 84/84, kernel Kbuild passed, diff checks passed.
